headline: Walk Through History with Expert Guides
primaryText: If you are curious about ancient empires, lost cities, and forgotten worlds then come and explore them with us! In the company of our passionate experts, uncover hidden layers of archaeology and history that most visitors miss.
description: Peter Sommer Travels: Expert-led Cultural Tours and Gulet Cruises
whyItWorks: It opens by speaking to a specific type of person, the history enthusiast, and promises access to things ordinary tourists never see. The vertical video shows real visitors climbing ancient stone steps, so the experience feels tangible and easy to picture. It has been running for more than seven months, which suggests it performs well enough to keep funded.
